# tomlc99 (vendored)

TOML parser in C99 by CK Tan, MIT licence (LICENSE in this folder).
Source: https://github.com/cktan/tomlc99, commit 29076dfd095bbbbd50a3c1b2760d29f4b83e74ac
(2026-01-30). Only toml.c and toml.h are copied, unchanged.

Used by the mod platform (port/src/mods, task-11) for mod.toml manifests,
mods/load_order.toml and save records, in the game and in modctl_core.exe.
